rows.headline: DIIs record longest selling streak in four years

This trend reflects a broader move toward diversifying global currency reserves and payment systems. The Jal Jeevan Mission is a major national infrastructure initiative aimed at providing safe drinking water to rural households. Cost efficiencies in execution directly impact infrastructure contractors and the broader fiscal deficit. rows.winners_losers: Infrastructure taxpayers gain / inefficient contractors hurt

rows.headline: Global bond yields surge to multi-year highs amid inflation and borrowing concerns
rows.hook: Sovereign debt yields hit multi-year highs globally

modes.bear: Persistent fiscal deficits and sticky global inflation threaten to push yields higher, increasing borrowing costs.
modes.bull: Elevated yields offer attractive entry points for medium-term fixed income investors looking to lock in higher returns.
modes.simple: Governments are paying higher interest to borrow money because of inflation. This makes loans more expensive for everyone and affects financial markets.

rows.summary: Sovereign debt sell-offs pushed government bond yields across major economies to multi-year highs due to sticky inflation and high borrowing. The US 10-year Treasury reached levels unseen since 2002, while Japanese yields hit 1996 highs. India's benchmark 10-year yield touched a four-year high of 7.50% in October before closing at 7.24%. While easing crude oil prices have helped bond recoveries, persistent fiscal concerns and monetary tightening expectations keep the outlook uncertain.
rows.why_it_matters: Higher bond yields raise borrowing costs and pressure domestic equity valuations.
rows.winners_losers: Fixed income investors gain / equity markets hurt

rows.headline: India's retail inflation reaches 6.09% in latest data

modes.bear: Persistent inflation above the RBI's target forces the central bank to maintain high interest rates, squeezing corporate margins and consumer spending.
modes.bull: Higher inflation can sometimes signal robust domestic demand and economic activity, potentially supporting revenue growth for pricing-power companies.
modes.simple: When inflation is high, the cost of living rises. This usually forces the central bank to keep interest rates high, which makes loans more expensive and can slow down the stock market.

rows.summary: India's retail inflation rate climbed to 6.09%, marking a 24-month high. This figure exceeds the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6%. Elevated food and fuel prices are primary drivers behind this inflationary pressure. Retail investors face potential volatility as high inflation complicates the central bank's interest rate policy outlook.
rows.whats_next: Next RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting
rows.why_it_matters: Rate cuts may be delayed, keeping borrowing costs higher for longer.
